title: Wormwood
lead: Wormwood is a bitter plant, and in the Bible it is the taste of sin and of judgment: a root that bears poison and wormwood (Deuteronomy 29:18), the bitter end of the adulteress (Proverbs 5:4), justice turned into wormwood (Amos 5:7), and the falling star named Wormwood (Revelation 8:11).
